title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p4bl: hardcoded class E options in test_request_protection_vectors instead of reading from plaintext.options
description:
## Issue

In `tests/vectors.rs` line 336, the class E options are hardcoded:

```rust
&hex_to_bytes("b3747631"),
```

Instead of reading from the vector data:

```rust
&hex_to_bytes(&plaintext.options),
```

While C4, C5, C6 all happen to have the same options hex `b3747631`, any future request_protection vector added to `oscore.json` with different options would be tested with incorrect input.

## Location

`rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs:336` in `test_request_protection_vectors`
